pages.title: The 3-Layer System
pages.text: Your character has three layers of identity, chosen in order:$(br2)$(bold)1. Origin$() — What species you are. 13 options with unique flavor powers (flight, phasing, wall-climbing). $(bold)Permanent.$()$(br2)$(bold)2. Race$() — What people you belong to. 11 options with stat modifiers and thematic traits. $(bold)Permanent.$()$(br2)$(bold)3. Class$() — What you do in combat. 10 options. Respec-able via Class Altar.

pages.title: What to Pick If...
pages.text: $(bold)Want to hit things:$()$(br)$(thing)Berserker$() (axes, low-HP rage), $(thing)Samurai$() (katanas, precision), $(thing)Orc$() or $(thing)Fallen Angel$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to cast spells:$()$(br)$(thing)Archmage$() (pure magic, glass cannon), $(thing)Battlemage$() (melee+magic), $(thing)Faefolk$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to tank:$()$(br)$(thing)Vanguard$() (pure tank), $(thing)Paladin$() (tank+heals), $(thing)Demi-God$() or $(thing)Dwarf$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to explore:$()$(br)$(thing)Wanderer$() (jack of all trades), $(thing)Ranger$() (fast), $(thing)Kirin$() or $(thing)Elf$() race

pages.title: More Builds
pages.text: $(bold)Want to build/craft:$()$(br)$(thing)Artificer$() class, $(thing)Dwarf$() or $(thing)Halfling$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to summon:$()$(br)$(thing)Void Summoner$() class, $(thing)Revenant$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to hyperscale:$()$(br)$(thing)Witch of Ink$() or $(thing)Artificial Construct$() origin$(br2)$(bold)Don't know what you want:$()$(br)$(thing)Mundane$() origin + $(thing)Human$() race + $(thing)Wanderer$() class. No penalties, bonus XP, try everything. Respec your class later.$(br2)$(italic)Remember: Origin and Race are permanent. Class can be changed. When in doubt, pick safe defaults.$()

pages.title: Getting Started with Magic
pages.text: Magic is available from $(t1)Tier 1$():$(br2)$(bold)Iron's Spells & Spellbooks$() — Craft a $(bold)Copper Spell Book$() early. Find spell scrolls in dungeon chests. Inscribe scrolls into your book to learn spells. Upgrade to better spell books as you progress.$(br2)$(bold)Botania$() — Also $(t1)Tier 1$(). Mana flowers, mana pools, and botanical tools. Excellent for $(thing)Faefolk$() and $(thing)Battlemage$() builds.$(br2)$(bold)Ars Nouveau$() — Available at $(t2)Tier 2$(). Custom spell crafting with glyphs. More complex but extremely powerful.

pages.title: Getting Your First Gear
pages.text: $(bold)Apotheosis Affixes$() — Mob drops can have random affixes (stat bonuses, gem sockets). Kill $(thing)Champions$() (glowing mobs) for the best early gear.$(br2)$(bold)Tetra Workbench$() — Craft a Tetra workbench to customize weapons and tools. Swap out handles, blades, and guards with different materials.$(br2)$(bold)Food Diversity$() — $(thing)Spice of Life: Carrot Edition$() rewards eating different foods with permanent max HP bonuses. Eat a wide variety early for free health.

pages.title: Tier Progression Basics
pages.text: $(bold)T1 tokens$() drop from dungeon chests and early boss kills. Use them to unlock $(t2)Tier 2$() content.$(br2)$(bold)Boss kills advance tiers.$() Each tier has required bosses that must be defeated to progress.$(br2)$(bold)Explore before you fight.$() Dungeons have valuable loot, spell scrolls, and tokens. You don't need to rush boss fights — gear up first.$(br2)$(bold)Check your FTB Quests book$() for specific progression requirements and rewards at each tier.
